Looking at the pattern - the model seems to be under-predicting when sentiment is positive (sentiment = 1.00 or 0.67) and over-predicting (under-predicting lows) when sentiment is negative?


I notice a nuanced relationship between sentiment and price predictions. When sentiment shifts from negative to positive, the model struggles to adapt quickly. Specifically, the forecasts lag behind actual price movements, especially at key sentiment turning points.
